Hi Sophie,

Thanks — appreciate the context. Short answer: we can support the downgrade and preserve the Conversational QoS capability, but there are a few options depending on how you want credits/fees handled. Outline below so we can pick a path quickly:

Option A — Standard step-down (default)
- Downgrade effective at your next billing cycle.
- Unused committed capacity is converted to a pro-rata credit applied over the remaining contract term (no cash refund).
- Conversational QoS: available as an add-on at list price.

Option B — Step-down with one-time smoothing credit (recommended for customer experience)
- One-time customer credit applied to next invoice to offset step-down.
- Keep Conversational QoS as an add-on at a discounted rate (we can offer 25% off for the first 3 months).
- We can limit the credit to preserve deal economics (example below).

Option C — Temporary hybrid (pilot-friendly)
- Scale to Compact-High for 3 months, keep Throughput+ reserved capacity for critical routes (burst pool), then re-evaluate.
- We place a capped burst bucket (pay-as-you-go) to preserve SLOs for triage flows.

Numbers to illustrate (ballpark):
- Current committed monthly (Throughput+): $72,000
- Compact-High committed monthly: $43,000
- Pro-rata window remaining (Nov–Feb): ~4 months of commitment remaining
- Suggested one-time smoothing credit (Option B): $15,000–$20,000 applied to the first invoice after amendment
- Conversational QoS add-on list: $8k/month; discounted 25% first 3 months = $6k/month

If you want, I can draft an amendment with the Option you prefer. Copying Kimberly from Finance and Lauren from CS to confirm approvals and operational impacts.

Would you have 20 minutes today or tomorrow to lock in which of the above you prefer?

Best,
Olga
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Lauren — quick internal note before I confirm to CareLoop. Sophie wants Option B (one-time smoothing credit and discounted add-on). She asked for ~$15k and a Nov 1 effective date with an amendment in hand by Oct 10.

Proposal from our side:
- Approve a one-time non-recurring credit of $15,000 applied to Nov invoice.
- Offer Conversational QoS at 25% off for first 3 months, then revert to list.
- No change to renewal date (Feb 2029). Unused committed capacity converted to pro-rata credit for term (not cash).
- Include a clause: if CareLoop returns to Throughput+ within 90 days, we will credit back 50% of the one-time credit as goodwill.

Rationale: retains revenue over term, lowers churn risk, keeps SLOs intact (good for case studies), and matches precedent for mid-market step-downs.

Please confirm if Finance signs off on the $15k and legal can push a short amendment (I can draft). If you prefer $20k I can push harder but would like a yes/no on $15k.

Thanks — Olga
